requirements.title: Public-content access
requirements.limitations: Sampled robots policies and our own network responses do not verify reachability from other providers or their infrastructure.

requirements.title: Canonical first-party documentation
requirements.limitations: Canonical metadata does not establish that documentation answers customer questions or stays current.

requirements.title: Sitemap discovery
requirements.limitations: Parsing a sitemap does not verify complete page coverage or its declaration in robots.txt.

requirements.title: Linked AI resource catalog
requirements.limitations: One /.well-known/ai-catalog.json request plus sampled rel="ai-catalog" links. JSON syntax and listed URLs are recorded; the catalog schema, completeness and listed resources are not verified, and homepage-specific linking is not separated from other sampled pages.

requirements.title: Useful initial HTML
requirements.limitations: The bounded raw/rendered text comparison is a heuristic; it does not verify that a specific answer is present.

requirements.title: Honest HTTP responses
requirements.limitations: One random missing path and observed HTTP responses are sampled. Redirect intent and throttling reliability are not established.

requirements.title: Homepage HTML and navigation
requirements.limitations: Homepage text growth is sampled. Links to documentation, product and pricing destinations are not independently verified.

requirements.title: Task-answering documentation
requirements.limitations: Metadata and semantic HTML checks do not assess documentation accuracy or task coverage.

requirements.title: Usable code examples
requirements.limitations: Only bounded HTML pre/code annotations are inspected. Source Markdown fences, inline examples, language correctness and executability are not verified.

requirements.title: Links to discovery resources
requirements.limitations: Only sampled HTML/HTTP Link references and a bounded same-site validation subset are inspected. Unlinked paths and skipped targets cannot establish full coverage.

requirements.title: Described llms.txt index
requirements.limitations: Presence and structural checks do not verify descriptive coverage, linked destinations or agent adoption.

requirements.title: Grounded JSON-LD and visible facts
requirements.limitations: Supported syntax and field checks do not verify business facts, page coverage or agreement with visible text.

requirements.title: Discoverable Markdown alternatives
requirements.limitations: Sampled HTML and HTTP Link advertisements are counted and at most one mirror is fetched. Agreement with the HTML page and Accept-header content negotiation are not assessed.

requirements.title: Readable first-party pricing
requirements.limitations: Pricing pages are identified by URL or main heading in the bounded sample. Currency amounts or an explicit free plan in initial HTML are observed; plan, free-tier and limit completeness and accuracy are not verified.

requirements.title: Agent-usable authentication
requirements.limitations: Authentication metadata and delegated authorization on the target product are not tested.

requirements.title: Public API contract
requirements.limitations: Only OpenAPI documents linked from sampled pages, HTTP Link headers or the AI Catalog are fetched, with a basic JSON structure check. Whether a public API exists, operations, authentication and YAML contracts are not assessed.

requirements.title: Usable MCP interface
requirements.limitations: MCP discovery, transport and tool behavior are not assessed.

requirements.title: MCP discovery card
requirements.limitations: Only a server card listed in the AI Catalog is fetched and checked as a JSON object. Reserved endpoint paths are not guessed; the draft card format, server capabilities and transport are not tested.

requirements.title: Agent-hosted interface
requirements.limitations: MCP Apps views are not assessed.

requirements.title: SDK and command-line access
requirements.limitations: Published SDKs, installation and CLI workflows are not tested.

requirements.title: In-page agent tools
requirements.limitations: HTML labels are not evidence of WebMCP registration or safe tool behavior.

requirements.title: Agent-usable payments
requirements.limitations: The target product’s payment protocols and checkout are not assessed. Our own Stripe integration is not target-site evidence.

requirements.title: Structured question endpoint
requirements.limitations: NLWeb discovery and answer behavior are not assessed.

requirements.title: Operable action interface
requirements.limitations: MCP/CLI availability and task completion are not assessed. Applicability depends on the target product and remains undetermined.
